caption: The drawing depicts three main objects within a large, lightly outlined square on a plain, beige background. At the top center is an oval-shaped object with a yellow border and a pinkish-orange interior, featuring an engraved figure of a seated person facing left, holding an object, with a stylized tree or plant to their left. Below this, on the left side, is a simple line drawing labeled "Back View," showing an oval outline with a horizontal straight line across it, terminating in small perpendicular lines at each end. To the right of this, another simple line drawing labeled "Side View" shows a vertical, slightly curved line representing the profile of the same object. The drawings utilize fine, precise lines in pencil for the outlines and details, while the engraving at the top is colored with shades of yellow, pink, orange, and off-white.
title: Cameo Brooch
